content_blocks.text: Thank you to everyone who took part in the 2021-2022 PLA annual essay competition in memory of Rosie Choueka. We would like to also take this opportunity to thank the judges: John Houlden, Burges Salmon, Kieran McGaughey, Newcastle CC, Anthony Woolich, HFW and Lisa Boyd, Gately Tweed.

content_blocks.text: The winner will receive £2000 and the joint runners’ up will each receive £750.
heading_path: Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2021-2022: RESULTS

content_blocks.text: All of the judges thought that this year’s entries were of a particularly high quality and it was an extremely close field – so thank you for making their jobs so tough!
heading_path: Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2021-2022: RESULTS

content_blocks.text: Sarah will be asked to present her essay to the membership at this autumn’s event and the three placed essayists will all be presented their prizes by Rosie’s family.
heading_path: Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2021-2022: RESULTS

content_blocks.text: Further details will be provided closer to the time.
heading_path: Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2021-2022: RESULTS

content_blocks.text: In the meantime, many thanks to all of the essayists – and our congratulations to the winners.
